title: AutoReconnect-CN
description:
Automatically reconnect when kicked from the server and send the commands set in the configuration file. 
在你被踢出服务器时自动重连并发送在配置文件设定的指令
body:
**感谢使用，因已有同类模组且开发者有其他项目，无法分出时间开发此模组，所以此模组将永久停更；您可以继续使用，但不会受到技术支持！**[同类模组 点击前往](https://modrinth.com/mod/autoreconnectrf)

**Thank you for your support. Since there are already similar mods available and the developer is occupied with other projects with no time to spare for further development on this mod, it will be permanently discontinued. You may continue to use it, but technical support will not be provided.**
[Similar Mods – Click to Visit](https://modrinth.com/mod/autoreconnectrf)

You may get kicked from a server for various reasons while AFK. After installing this mod, it will automatically reconnect you if you get kicked. You can configure the command to be sent upon reconnection in the settings, which is useful for servers that require login or use multi-world plugins.
在服务器挂机时可能因为各种问题被踢出
安装这个模组后会在你被踢出服务器时自动重连
可以在配置中设定进入后发送的指令，这可以用于需要登录或有多世界插件的服务器
